markers.name: marciana V1
say: What are you two doing over there?

The storage room is off-limits.
Please return to your classroom.
markers.label: Marciana

markers.name: student 2 V1
say: What is this? Doesn't seem like anything special.
markers.label: Student

markers.name: resercher 1 V2
say: We have to succeed this time.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 2 V7
say: Focus on providing backup for the operation.
We have to do something to help.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 3 V6
say: We'll be able to take it down this time, right?
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: rei V4
say:
Mari... If I knew this would happen,
I would've given her all the chocolate.
markers.label: Rei

markers.name: resercher 1 V3
say: All right, let's have a get-together this week!
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 2 V8
say: Yeah! We've been working hard, so we deserve a break.
What do you want to serve at the get-together?
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 3 V7
say: I never expected to get to one of these things alive!
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: student 1 V4
say:
Good fortune in love, employment, and finances!
Ask me anything!
Hmm... Oh, things are looking up!
markers.label: Student

markers.name: student 1 V5
say: The fortune said we'd win all battles for sure.

Then we just keep going until we win!
Let's do this!
markers.label: Student

markers.name: student 2 V4
say: Haha! I'm a winner who spits in the face of losing!
markers.label: Student

markers.name: student 3 V5
say: Today's lunch was a bit disappointing...

No, tomorrow will be different.
Tomorrow there will be a new lunch!
markers.label: Student

markers.name: ein V5
say:
Huh? No way!
My Near Feather arrived first!
Uh... Could you turn a blind eye just this once?
markers.label: Ein

markers.name: marciana V4
say:
If you're not here personally, then you're late.
I want you to reflect and write me a letter of apology.
markers.label: Marciana

markers.name: rei V5
say: Huh? So even if Naru arrives first, it's not allowed?
Hmph... I really wanted to give it a try.
markers.label: Rei

markers.name: resercher 1 V4
say: How much more of the report do I have to write?
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 2 V9
say: Hang in there. We're almost done.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: rei V5
say: Wow, Ein and Zwei are really good!
Hehe, I'm gonna eat some chocolate!
markers.label: Rei

markers.name: resercher 2 V10
say: We'll be busy again starting next week, so take a rest.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: ein V1
say: What was that rumbling just now?
Could it be... a bomb attack?
markers.label: Ein

markers.name: student 2 V2
say: Are they preparing for a large-scale operation?
markers.label: Student

markers.name: student 3 V1
say: What's on the menu for lunch today?
markers.label: Student

markers.name: zwei V1
say: That earthquake came out of nowhere.
I wonder if Teacher is okay...
markers.label: Zwei

markers.name: ein V2
say: Hmm, that's a pretty uniform design too.
I'll have to make a sketch of it for later.
markers.label: Ein

markers.name: marciana V2
say: If you need anything pertaining to the school, let me know.
Would you like to look around the school first?
markers.label: Marciana

markers.name: rei V1
say:
This is Naru.
Naru likes chocolate!
markers.label: Rei

markers.name: resercher 2 V1
say: This monitor is only meant to be used in emergencies.
I doubt we'll ever need to use it, hehe.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: zwei V2
say: Uh... if you need any help, don't hesitate to ask me.
It was nice meeting with you.
markers.label: Zwei

markers.name: ether V1
say: A Massive Object which can change shape freely...
And the sheer output it's capable of is remarkable.
markers.label: Ether

markers.name: resercher 2 V2
say: I'm sure it'll be fine... most likely...
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 3 V2
say: Is it normal for there to be this many warning signals?
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: ain V3
say: I want to go out and play.
markers.label: Ein

markers.name: rei V2
say: I'm not a fan of team exercises.
markers.label: Rei

markers.name: resercher 1 V1
say: It was brutal getting a reservation at this place.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 2 V3
say: It can't be helped. It's an emergency.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: zwei V3
say: Where did she run off on her own?
markers.label: Zwei

markers.name: resercher 2 V4
say: No. These values shouldn't be coming out like this.
*Sigh* Move aside. I'll take a look.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 2 V5
say: We're all going to look at the sky together.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 3 V4
say: Even the Bunker Buster is surrounded by an Anti-Field!
If this falls to the surface, what happens to the Ark?
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: student 1 V2
say: Where did Zwei, Ein, and Rei go?
They didn't wander off somewhere dangerous, did they?
markers.label: Student

markers.name: student 2 V3
say: I think they said they were going on a mission a few days ago. Maybe that's where they went?
markers.label: Student

markers.name: ein V4
say: We have to take THAT down?
markers.label: Ein

markers.name: resercher 2 V6
say: Elite Nikkes are being deployed... it'll all work out somehow.
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: resercher 3 V5
say: Wh-what do we do? At this rate, the Ark will...!
markers.label: Researcher

markers.name: marciana V3
say: Has anyone seen Rei, Ein, and Zwei?
Or did they say where they were going off to?
markers.label: Marciana

markers.name: student 1 V3
say: Hmm... I don't think I've seen them at all today.
I'm sorry, Teacher. I haven't seen them.
markers.label: Student

markers.name: student 2 V4
say: I haven't heard anything from them either.
markers.label: Student

notes.text: The School Circle Squad has gone missing.
Permission to access the secret command room on campus has been granted.
Massive Object has launched Bunker Buster. The Ark's danger level has increased.
